amends: PLAN.json / SCHEMA-FREEZE.json (metrics02); frozen before any client edit
trigger: Mayor: native recorder must retain actual gateway rejection-body fields / raw response (no auth), not merely fate/status
observed_gap_in_original_client: _admission_rejection kept only detail + estimated_request_cost; non-success body kept only as body_bytes + body_sha256; x-request-id response header already recorded as record.request_id for every response
client_capture_schema: r24-resume-p0-nominal-client-v2 (record keys added; v1 captures are not finalized by v2 code)

record_additions.body_text: non-success response body retained verbatim as strict UTF-8 when <= MAX_RETAINED_BODY_BYTES (65536); else null
record_additions.body_text_null_reason: not_applicable (no non-success body) | body_read_incomplete | not_utf8 | over_65536_bytes | null when retained

rejection_record: classification rule UNCHANGED (503 + exact detail + estimated_request_cost key); retains detail, estimated_request_cost (finite number else null, unchanged), and verbatim estimated_input_tokens, estimated_output_tokens, max_admitted_cost, budget_version, plus fields_absent (gateway field names absent from the body; never invented)
not_recorded: request Authorization/cookies (none sent; no response headers stored except x-request-id); gateway admitted/terminal cost/budget/version telemetry is gateway-owned and joined by x-request-id, not observed by this recorder
tests: update the literal mock admission body to the gateway field shape and assert verbatim retention; one focused literal control for absent fields, non-admission 503 body, non-UTF-8 / oversized body
